suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam security impact analysis and mainnet fork decision
suggestions.rationale: ChainSecurity vulnerability in EIP-8037/8038 affecting 13+ major DeFi projects. Mainnet fork decision deferred until full impact analysis complete. Security researchers were to present findings at ACDT the week after ACDE #248.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7907 contract size metering decision for Hegota
suggestions.rationale: PFI raised in ACDE #247 because EIP-7954 created DoS surface without metering. Decision explicitly deferred to 'next call' (this one). No resolution captured yet.

suggestions.topic: Hegota devnet status: bogota-devnet-2 and hegota-devnet-0
suggestions.rationale: bogota-devnet-2 (EL-only, EIP-8253/4758/8298/8151) was to launch week of Oct 26. First merged devnet (hegota-devnet-0) targeted post-Devcon. FOCIL/frames interaction discussion scheduled for Devcon. Updates expected.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8368/8372 decision window: mainnet Glamsterdam data availability
suggestions.rationale: Both EIPs remain PFI pending ≥30 days of mainnet Glamsterdam data. With mainnet fork now delayed/uncertain, the decision timeline needs recalibration or these should be explicitly tabled.

suggestions.topic: CL block retention window alignment for BAL/history expiry
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #246 noted misalignment between EIP-8061 exit/consolidation churn changes and block retention window. ACDE #246 decided it's non-blocking for Gloas and should be resolved async via ETH R&D Discord thread, but no later meeting confirms resolution.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8077 eth/xx mempool networking spec expansion
suggestions.rationale: CFI'd conditionally in ACDE #247 on deeper analysis including fee/frame fields. Champion (Csaba) was to expand the proposal. No confirmation of spec update in later meetings.

suggestions.topic: Hegota CFI prioritization and SFI bar discussion
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #247 highlighted Hegota is already the most complex fork on record with 14 CFI/SFI EIPs before additional PFIs. ACDE #248 adopted nixo's CFI priority list as V1 and debated raising the CFI bar. Ongoing scoping refinement needed.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam ecosystem readiness and client rollback release status
suggestions.rationale: Hoodi fork canceled; all clients were to cut new rollback releases. Blog post was to be published immediately with pre-Glamsterdam client versions. Status update useful but likely resolved async.
